messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - Elevated 502/504 rate from API gateway (edge) — api.redwood.com — new spike starting 2028-03-15T01:12:09Z. Error-rate: 23% 5xx across edge proxies in us-east-1. Pager sent to @liam_oncall and ops rotation.

liam_oncall: Saw it. I'm on it. Starting triage. Is this regional only? Any recent deploys?

sara: No deploys in the last 30m from product. Metrics show spike ~01:10Z. K8s events show increased pod restarts on edge-proxy nodes.

james: I'm seeing upstream read timeouts in the gateway logs. Sample from edge-proxy-7ccf:
```
2028-03-15T01:11:58Z ERROR proxy: upstream read timeout: service=model-router-2, latency=12.4s, client=10.2.5.12
2028-03-15T01:12:02Z WARN response: 502 Bad Gateway from upstream
```

liam_oncall: Good. First quick mitigations: 1) enable 5xx circuit breaker at edge layer to shed failing upstreams, 2) shift a portion of traffic to us-west-2 for critical routes, 3) temporarily lower max inflight tokens for streaming endpoints.

nisha: Doing 1) now: `curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/edge/actuate -d '{"circuit_breaker":true}'` -> response 200. Applying config to us-east edge pool.

infra-bot: rollout started for edge-config v2028.3.15-cb1 -> target: edge-pool-us-east-1 (12 nodes). Status: 4/12 applied.

sara: I'm rolling a hotfix to bump connection pool size on model-router-2 and restarting targeted pods. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/model-router-2 --timeout=5m
```

james: Also noticed a spike in backend queue length for `finetune-svc` which proxies a lot of payloads. Could be causing head-of-line blocking.

liam_oncall: Temp mitigation: enable backend-level rate limit for non-critical internal routes. Nisha, can you patch the gateway rule to block large batch ingest endpoints for 10m?

nisha: Patch applied:
```
PATCH /gateway/rules/active
rules += {"path": "/v1/ingest*", "limit": "50r/m", "reason": "mitigation-2028-03-15"}
```
Response: 200 OK

ops-rotation: Customer impact estimate: ~18% of user requests failing globally, concentrated in us-east. Real-time dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/edge/502s?from=now-1h

liam_oncall: Good. Can we run a healthcheck sweep on edge proxies and report pods with >5xx%? Sara / infra-bot?

infra-bot: Health sweep results attached: 7 pods with error_rate > 15% (edge-proxy-3/7/9/12/15/18/21). Recommending targeted pod recycle.

sara: Recycling edge-proxy-9 and edge-proxy-12 now. `kubectl delete pod edge-proxy-9 -n prod` -> new pod creating. Monitoring.

james: After recycle, logs show fewer upstream timeouts on those nodes. Error rate dropped from 24% -> 6% on recycled nodes.

liam_oncall: Traffic shift check: route 30% of incoming session tokens to us-west-2 for critical API keys. Implemented via traffic-router: `trafficctl shift --from=us-east-1 --to=us-west-2 --pct=30 --route=api.v1.generate`

nisha: Traffic shift in effect. Observing reduced latency for shifted group. Overall 5xx decreased to ~9% across global fleet.

liam_oncall: Customer impact: Top 5 customers affected: acme-inc (10% errors), claritas (8%), buildly (7%), education-dept (6%), beta-testers (5%). Notifying CS to inform ACME and Claritas.

ops-rotation: Paging summary created: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2028-0315-01. Assigning to infra + runtime teams. Postmortem lead: @james. Action items in ticket.

sara: Plan to stabilize for next 30m then run graceful rollback of circuit-breaker and restore normal routing. If we see reversion of errors, we'll keep mitigations for 2h then remove.

liam_oncall: Agree. Handoff plan: I'll be on-call for next 25 minutes; @james take lead for the long tail. Please join a quick post-incident huddle at 02:00Z if stable.

james: Acknowledged. I'll prepare data dumps (request IDs, sample traces) for postmortem.

nisha: Leaving a note: potential root cause hypothesis - backend servicer node pool exhaustion + mis-sized connection pool. Adding to checklist.

infra-bot: Incident state: mitigation=active, severity=P0->P1 (stabilizing). Next update in 10m or on major change.

liam_oncall: Thanks team. Adding slack reactions :thumbsup: :white_check_mark:. Handing off to @james for follow-up. 

james: Taking handoff. I'm going to coordinate with CS for customer comms and schedule a postmortem slot. closing updates here once done.

ops-rotation: Final note: create runbook entry for circuit-breaker knob toggles we used today and add to oncall playbooks.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2028-0315-01 created; timeline started. If critical regression occurs, re-pager.
